component.name: subs2srs
component.summary: Create Anki flashcards from videos and subtitles

description.p: subs2srs turns TV shows and movies with subtitles into Anki flashcards for language learning. Each card gets the line in the language you're learning, an optional translation, an audio clip, a snapshot and optionally a video clip.
This is a native Linux port written in Rust with a GTK4 interface that follows your GTK theme in light and dark mode.
